description.value:
Your companion is a horse.

Support Benefit Until the start of your next turn, if you are mounted on your horse and moved 10 feet or more on the action before a melee Strike, add a circumstance bonus to damage for that Strike equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice. If your weapon already has the jousting trait, increase the trait's damage bonus by 2 per die instead.

Advanced Maneuver @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.companion-types.Item.Gallop]{Gallop}

Special The horse has the mount special ability. Choose Medium or Large when you gain it.
